gaps.lead: Yesterday, I informed my boss in writing that I would be leaving the company.
gaps.hint: inform your employer in writing = hand in your ___
gaps.explanation: 'Hand in one's notice' means formally resign.

gaps.lead: 'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.

gaps.lead: The athlete insisted that she had never taken banned substances.
gaps.explanation: deny having + past participle denies an earlier action.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.answer: as close to the beach as
gaps.lead: The hotel was further from the beach than we expected.
gaps.explanation: further than expected = not as close (to the beach) as expected.

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.
